title: ED pelvic pain documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Specifies pain pattern, menstrual, bladder, bowel, movement, posture, function and medication history plus abdominal and pelvic examination for focal tenderness or structural findings.
user_facing_items.population: Women presenting for the first time with chronic pelvic pain of at least 6 months that is not pregnancy-related.
user_facing_items.setting: General gynaecology and primary-care referral assessment.
restrictions: Exact for the chronic non-pregnancy subset only; old, international, and partial for acute, pregnancy-related, infectious, or emergency pelvic-pain presentations.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Defines chronic pelvic pain as a symptom rather than a diagnosis and frames initial assessment around the woman’s concerns, function, and multifactorial context.
user_facing_items.population: Women presenting for the first time with chronic pelvic pain of at least 6 months that is not pregnancy-related.
user_facing_items.setting: General gynaecology and primary-care referral assessment.
restrictions: Exact for the chronic non-pregnancy subset only; old, international, and partial for acute, pregnancy-related, infectious, or emergency pelvic-pain presentations.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Lists pain, amenorrhoea, bleeding, gastrointestinal symptoms, dizziness or syncope, shoulder-tip pain, urinary symptoms, tenderness, haemodynamic signs, pregnancy testing, and escalation criteria.
user_facing_items.population: Women, trans men, and non-binary people with pain, bleeding, or other complications in early pregnancy up to 13 completed weeks.
user_facing_items.setting: Primary, emergency, gynaecology, and early pregnancy assessment services.
restrictions: Exact for early-pregnancy pain, bleeding, ectopic-pregnancy warning signs, ultrasound, and hCG assessment; partial for uncomplicated pregnancy symptoms and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: When pregnancy is possible or known, the exact NICE section supports recording vital data, time-critical symptoms and clinician-decided escalation without asserting ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Defines clinician-performed transvaginal or selected transabdominal ultrasound and cautions against overinterpreting one early scan or LMP alone.
user_facing_items.population: Women, trans men, and non-binary people with pain, bleeding, or other complications in early pregnancy up to 13 completed weeks.
user_facing_items.setting: Primary, emergency, gynaecology, and early pregnancy assessment services.
restrictions: Exact for early-pregnancy pain, bleeding, ectopic-pregnancy warning signs, ultrasound, and hCG assessment; partial for uncomplicated pregnancy symptoms and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: When early pregnancy applies, the exact ultrasound section supports recording imaging or test results already performed or reviewed, without recommending or interpreting them.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports clinician-selected STI sampling when PID is suspected and transvaginal ultrasound for adnexal masses and selected chronic pelvic-pain pathology.
